translation: I, your servant, say that below the Three Dynasties, the one with flourishing culture and artifacts must be said to be the Western Han; it only used the imperial physician Li Zhuguo to collate the arts of formulas, and never ordered the Confucian ministers. Although I, your servant, blow in the Confucian learning without merit, I only exhaust what I have heard and seen to correct it, and where there is doubt I await the coming worthies. In all, forty volumes, together with one volume of table of contents.
